items.summary: Week 1 vs Seattle: 18 carries for 51 yards and 5 receptions on 6 targets for 44 yards. Heavy all-around workload with TreVeyon Henderson unavailable.
items.fantasy_significance: Positive role confirmation; no roster action required.

items.summary: Week 1: 8 catches on 11 targets for 122 yards and a touchdown despite Sam Darnold leaving on the opening drive. NBC Sports reported a 41.7% target share. Darnold has no fracture but further evaluation is pending.
items.fantasy_significance: Strong WR1 role remains intact even if Drew Lock starts; no roster action required.

items.summary: Brock Bowers underwent a meniscus trim and is expected to miss one or two games. Mayer is expected to take on the larger tight-end role while Bowers is out.
items.fantasy_significance: Mayer remains a strong short-term hold/start; monitor Bowers' return timetable before any TE pivot.

items.summary: Ravens WR Devontez Walker was limited with a groin injury. Beat reporting indicates Lane and Elijah Sarratt would be candidates for increased work if Walker cannot play; Zay Flowers also practiced limited but expects to play.
items.fantasy_significance: Hold/watch only; not enough evidence for lineup promotion yet.

items.summary: Miami continues to list Caleb Douglas as a Week 1 starting receiver alongside Chris Bell and Malik Washington.
items.fantasy_significance: Positive stash confirmation; no roster action required.

notification_reason: No confirmed Sparta free-agent upgrade or urgent lineup move identified. External candidates without Sparta-specific availability evidence remain UNKNOWN and were not recommended.
